meta.register: Cadastro Nacional de Enderecos para Fins Estatisticos (CNEFE), Censo Demografico 2022
meta.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatistica (IBGE)
meta.licence: Public domain on condition the source is cited (IBGE), Brazilian federal open data (Decreto 8.777/2016)
meta.attribution: Fonte: IBGE, Cadastro Nacional de Enderecos para Fins Estatisticos, Censo Demografico 2022
meta.notes: all 27 UF files; SIRGAS 2000 (EPSG:4674, per Nota metodologica n. 01) to WGS84 by PROJ; NV_GEO_COORD 4 (block face midpoint), 5 (localidade) and 6 (census tract centroid) marked estimated, 1 to 3 kept as Nota metodologica n. 01 classes them as geocoded at the address; any complemento element marks a unit; DSC_MODIFICADOR SN means no number (so 97% of DF, which IBGE records as SN), KM gives 'KM <n>', any other modifier follows the number as IBGE says it complements it; road is tipo, titulo and nome of the logradouro, without IBGE's pseudo-tipo EDF (Endereco do Distrito Federal); suburb is DSC_LOCALIDADE, city is the municipality name from IBGE DTB 2022 by COD_MUNICIPIO, state is the UF code of the file name; rows of one COD_UNICO_ENDERECO listed once per especie with identical address fields are one address; CNEFE's capitals title-cased, Portuguese particles lower-cased
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS
